name: Wan2.1
notes: Official README requires torch >= 2.4.0.
Use --offload_model True and --t5_cpu when memory is tight on single-GPU hosts.
The same codebase covers both the T2V and I2V checkpoints.

sample_scripts.title: Wan2.1 T2V 14B smoke test
commands: python generate.py --task t2v-14B --size 1280*720 --ckpt_dir "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/wan2.1/Wan2.1-T2V-14B" --offload_model True --prompt "${PROMPT:-Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage.}" --save_file "$OUTPUT_ROOT/wan2.1/wan2.1-t2v-14b.mp4"

sample_scripts.title: Wan2.1 I2V 14B 720P smoke test
commands: python generate.py --task i2v-14B --size 1280*720 --ckpt_dir "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/wan2.1/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P" --image "$INPUT_IMAGE" --offload_model True --prompt "${PROMPT:-Summer beach vacation style, a white cat wearing sunglasses sits on a surfboard.}" --save_file "$OUTPUT_ROOT/wan2.1/wan2.1-i2v-14b-720p.mp4"

name: HunyuanVideo-1.5
install_steps: uv pip install --python .venv310/bin/python -r requirements.txt torch==2.6.0 torchvision==0.21.0 torchaudio==2.6.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126 --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple
notes: Official source-code inference supports both T2V and I2V through generate.py.
Use --rewrite false if you do not have a vLLM-compatible prompt rewrite service.
For the 480p step-distilled I2V checkpoint, the upstream README recommends 8 or 12 steps.
The upstream checkpoints-download guide also requires Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, google/byt5-small, Glyph-SDXL-v2, and a gated SigLIP encoder from FLUX.1-Redux-dev.
On DPLab's current 570.124.06 driver, the torch/torchvision/torchaudio 2.6.0 trio resolves cleanly via the cu126 index.
If FLUX.1-Redux-dev access is not approved yet, use the T2V smoke test first; only the I2V path needs the SigLIP vision encoder.
For smoke tests, make sure the local checkpoint layout includes root config.json plus scheduler/, vae/, and the target transformer/* subtree before launching generate.py.
download_steps: echo "Download Glyph-SDXL-v2 from ModelScope into $WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/text_encoder/Glyph-SDXL-v2 before running the Hunyuan smoke test."
echo "Request FLUX.1-Redux-dev access, then download the SigLIP encoder into $WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/vision_encoder/siglip before running the Hunyuan smoke test."

sample_scripts.title: HunyuanVideo-1.5 480P T2V smoke test
commands: [ -f "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/config.json" ] || { echo "Missing Hunyuan root config under $WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/config.json" >&2; exit 1; }

[ -f "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/transformer/480p_t2v/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors" ] || { echo "Missing 480p T2V transformer weights under $WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/transformer/480p_t2v" >&2; exit 1; }

torchrun --nproc_per_node="${NPROC_PER_NODE:-1}" generate.py --prompt "${PROMPT:-A cinematic close-up of a lemon tart on a wooden table, shot with soft natural light.}" --image_path None --resolution 480p --aspect_ratio 16:9 --seed "${SEED:-1}" --num_inference_steps "${NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS:-12}" --video_length "${VIDEO_LENGTH:-49}" --rewrite false --cfg_distilled false --enable_step_distill false --use_sageattn false --sparse_attn false --enable_cache true --cache_type deepcache --overlap_group_offloading false --sr false --output_path "$OUTPUT_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/hunyuanvideo-1.5-t2v.mp4" --model_path "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5"

sample_scripts.title: HunyuanVideo-1.5 480P I2V step-distilled smoke test
commands: [ -f "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/config.json" ] || { echo "Missing Hunyuan root config under $WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/config.json" >&2; exit 1; }

torchrun --nproc_per_node="${NPROC_PER_NODE:-1}" generate.py --prompt "${PROMPT:-Summer beach vacation style, a white cat wearing sunglasses sits on a surfboard.}" --image_path "$INPUT_IMAGE" --resolution 480p --aspect_ratio 16:9 --seed "${SEED:-1}" --num_inference_steps "${NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS:-8}" --video_length "${VIDEO_LENGTH:-49}" --rewrite false --cfg_distilled true --enable_step_distill true --use_sageattn false --sparse_attn false --enable_cache true --cache_type deepcache --overlap_group_offloading false --sr false --output_path "$OUTPUT_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/hunyuanvideo-1.5-i2v.mp4" --model_path "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5"

name: Open-Sora v2
notes: The current repo tree uses configs under configs/diffusion/inference/, for example 256px.py.
Those configs expect repo-relative checkpoint files under ./ckpts, including Open_Sora_v2.safetensors, hunyuan_vae.safetensors, T5, CLIP, and flux plugin weights.
This is the heaviest setup in the shortlist, so it stays as a research baseline rather than a first smoke test.
download_steps: echo "Copy or symlink the required checkpoint files into $CODE_ROOT/Open-Sora/ckpts to match configs/diffusion/inference/*.py"

name: Mochi 1
install_steps: uv pip install --python .venv310/bin/python --force-reinstall torch==2.8.0 torchvision==0.23.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128  # DPLab 570.x-compatible torch stack
notes: The official repo uses uv already, so this is the cleanest upstream environment to reproduce on DPLab.
Install ffmpeg before trying to export videos from the CLI or Gradio UI.
CPU offload is only supported in single-GPU mode.
On DPLab's current 570.124.06 driver, the default uv resolution pulled torch 2.11.0+cu130 and failed CUDA initialization; force the cu128 torch/torchvision pair above before smoke testing.

The CLI also loads google/t5-v1_1-xxl through Hugging Face cache. Treat that text encoder as a separate heavyweight dependency and pre-populate it intentionally instead of letting the sample script fetch it implicitly.
If your environment already defines HF_TOKEN_PATH, the smoke helpers will preserve it. They no longer guess a token-file location on your behalf.
download_steps: echo "Mochi also needs google/t5-v1_1-xxl in $HF_HOME/hub/models--google--t5-v1_1-xxl; pre-populate that cache intentionally before running mochi_cli.sh."

sample_scripts.title: Mochi 1 CLI smoke test
commands: [ -d "$HF_HOME/hub/models--google--t5-v1_1-xxl" ] || { echo "Missing google/t5-v1_1-xxl in $HF_HOME/hub/models--google--t5-v1_1-xxl. Populate the HF cache intentionally before running Mochi." >&2; exit 1; }

! find "$HF_HOME/hub/models--google--t5-v1_1-xxl" -name "*.incomplete" -print -quit | grep -q . || { echo "Found incomplete google/t5-v1_1-xxl downloads under $HF_HOME. Finish or clean them before running Mochi." >&2; exit 1; }

[ "$(du -sm "$HF_HOME/hub/models--google--t5-v1_1-xxl" | awk '{print $1}')" -ge 20000 ] || { echo "google/t5-v1_1-xxl cache under $HF_HOME looks incomplete (<20G). Populate it explicitly before running Mochi." >&2; exit 1; }

python3 ./demos/cli.py --model_dir "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/mochi-1-preview" --cpu_offload --prompt "${PROMPT:-A cinematic close-up of a lemon tart on a wooden table, shot with soft natural light.}" --seed "${SEED:-12345}" --out_dir "$OUTPUT_ROOT/mochi-1"

name: CogVideoX1.5
install_steps: pip install --upgrade transformers accelerate diffusers imageio-ffmpeg
notes: The model card recommends BF16 and lists 9 GB minimum GPU memory for single-GPU inference.
The published model card is English-only.
For first-pass MMVGM integration, treat this as a low-friction fallback rather than the primary benchmark family.
